company_name: Jiangsu Nata Opto-electronic Material Co., Ltd.
semiconductor_relevance: High — Jiangsu Nata Opto-electronic Material Co., Ltd. is a leading manufacturer of high purity metal organics used in semiconductor processes.
summary: Jiangsu Nata Opto-electronic Material Co., Ltd. specializes in the production of high purity metal organics (MO sources) essential for MOCVD tools in semiconductor manufacturing. Established in 2000, the company has advanced production capabilities and holds multiple certifications, positioning it as a top supplier globally.
capabilities: High purity metal organics for MOCVD
TMGa, TMIn, TEGa, TMAl, DEZn, DMZn, Cp2Mg production

regional_presence.China: The company is located in Suzhou Industrial Park, China, and is recognized as the largest manufacturer of MO sources in the country.
